# EXCESS 0.4.53

**Transient Shaper — cleaner splits**
- Rebuilt as a click-free transient/sustain split: both Attack and Sustain dials are
  always live, and the bottom of either dial fully mutes that half so you can isolate
  transients or sustain (great as an EXCESS Separator — the Difference chain gets the
  clean complement for reverb). New "Isolate Transients / Sustain" presets.
- Short lookahead removes the onset click on the isolated component and on the reverb send.

**Dynamics / automation fixes**
- Gate: click-free gain path + new **Range** control (how far it attenuates; defaults to full mute).
- Clipper / Distortion output link no longer fights host automation when you automate the ceiling/drive.
- Multiband Comp: auto loudness-match backs off gracefully when you automate Output.

**Interface**
- Preset **‹ / ›** browsing with the active preset name shown on the Presets button.
- All pop-up dialogs (Save Preset, confirmations, errors, About) restyled on-brand and
  centered over the plugin.
